name: ui-skill-2045
description: Curated, rewritten Agent Skills for accessible, intentional frontend and UI work. Bilingual (ID/EN).

skills.name: accessibility-wcag
skills.description: Use when auditing or building UI that must work with keyboards, screen readers, zoom, high contrast, and reduced motion, or when fixing WCAG AA failures.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat mengaudit atau membangun UI yang harus bekerja dengan keyboard, screen reader, zoom, kontras tinggi, dan reduced motion, atau saat memperbaiki kegagalan WCAG AA.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: anti-slop-design
skills.description: Use when a page looks generic, templated, or obviously AI-generated, or when starting a design that must have a specific point of view rather than the default SaaS look.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat halaman terlihat generik, seperti template, atau jelas dibuat AI, atau saat memulai desain yang harus punya sudut pandang khusus, bukan tampilan SaaS bawaan.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: color-contrast
skills.description: Use when choosing a palette, checking WCAG contrast, fixing unreadable text, or making light and dark themes that stay accessible.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat memilih palet, memeriksa kontras WCAG, memperbaiki teks yang sulit dibaca, atau membuat tema terang dan gelap yang tetap aksesibel.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: dark-mode
skills.description: Use when adding dark mode, fixing a dark theme created by inversion, or when surfaces, shadows, and accent colors lose hierarchy after switching themes.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat menambahkan dark mode, memperbaiki tema gelap hasil inversi, atau ketika permukaan, bayangan, dan warna aksen kehilangan hierarki setelah berganti tema.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: dashboard-admin
skills.description: Use when designing dashboards, admin panels, analytics views, or any dense screen people work in, especially when metrics, tables, and filters compete for attention.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat merancang dashboard, panel admin, tampilan analitik, atau layar padat tempat orang bekerja, terutama ketika metrik, tabel, dan filter saling berebut perhatian.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: design-system-tokens
skills.description: Use when starting a UI, defining CSS variables, or replacing scattered color, spacing, radius, and shadow values with one stable token contract.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat memulai antarmuka, mendefinisikan variabel CSS, atau mengganti nilai warna, jarak, radius, dan bayangan yang tersebar dengan satu kontrak token yang stabil.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: empty-error-states
skills.description: Use when designing first-run screens, zero-result views, 404/500 pages, loading states, or failure messages that currently blame the user or say nothing useful.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat merancang layar pertama, hasil kosong, halaman 404/500, loading, atau pesan kegagalan yang saat ini menyalahkan pengguna atau tidak menjelaskan apa pun.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: frontend-performance
skills.description: Use when a page loads slowly, shifts while loading, ships too much JavaScript, or animates poorly on mid-range phones.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat halaman lambat dimuat, bergeser saat loading, mengirim terlalu banyak JavaScript, atau beranimasi buruk di ponsel kelas menengah.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: motion-system
skills.description: Use when adding transitions, page-load animation, scroll effects, or interaction feedback, and when motion feels gratuitous, janky, or ignores reduced-motion preferences.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat menambahkan transisi, animasi saat halaman dimuat, efek scroll, atau umpan balik interaksi, dan ketika gerak terasa berlebihan, patah-patah, atau mengabaikan preferensi reduced-motion.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: nextjs-react-patterns
skills.description: Use when building Next.js App Router interfaces, deciding server versus client components, handling streaming, forms, metadata, or fixing hydration and data-fetching mistakes.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat membangun antarmuka Next.js App Router, menentukan server versus client component, menangani streaming, form, metadata, atau memperbaiki kesalahan hidrasi dan pengambilan data.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: responsive-adaptive
skills.description: Use when a layout breaks on phones or tablets, when mobile is only a shrunk desktop, or when building fluid type, containers, and touch-first interactions.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat tata letak rusak di ponsel atau tablet, saat mobile hanya versi desktop yang diperkecil, atau saat membangun tipografi fluida, kontainer, dan interaksi sentuh.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: spacing-layout
skills.description: Use when a layout feels cramped, randomly spaced, or pushed to one side, or when building page grids, section rhythm, and responsive containers from scratch.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat tata letak terasa sempit, jaraknya acak, atau konten menumpuk di satu sisi, atau saat membangun grid halaman, irama seksi, dan kontainer responsif dari nol.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: tailwind-shadcn
skills.description: Use when building with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, especially when class lists become unreadable, tokens drift, or components lose accessibility and dark mode.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat membangun dengan Tailwind CSS dan shadcn/ui, terutama ketika daftar class menjadi tidak terbaca, token melenceng, atau komponen kehilangan aksesibilitas dan dark mode.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: theme-recipes
skills.description: Use when choosing or implementing a visual theme (neumorphism, glass, aurora, brutalist, neon, bento, editorial, clay, and others) and when a theme must work in light, dark, and accessible combinations.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat memilih atau menerapkan tema visual (neumorphism, glass, aurora, brutalist, neon, bento, editorial, clay, dan lainnya) dan ketika tema harus bekerja dalam mode terang, gelap, dan kombinasi yang aksesibel.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: typography-system
skills.description: Use when choosing typefaces, building a type scale, fixing hierarchy, or making headlines and body text feel intentional rather than default.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat memilih typeface, menyusun skala tipografi, memperbaiki hierarki, atau membuat judul dan teks isi terasa disengaja, bukan bawaan.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: ui-audit-review
skills.description: Use when reviewing an existing interface for usability, visual quality, accessibility, and consistency, or when asked for a design critique with prioritized fixes.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat meninjau antarmuka yang ada untuk kegunaan, kualitas visual, aksesibilitas, dan konsistensi, atau saat diminta kritik desain dengan perbaikan berprioritas.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: ui-components
skills.description: Use when building or fixing buttons, cards, forms, tables, and navigation, especially when components look inconsistent or have missing hover, focus, loading, and error states.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat membangun atau memperbaiki tombol, kartu, form, tabel, dan navigasi, terutama ketika komponen tidak konsisten atau kehilangan state hover, focus, loading, dan error.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors

skills.name: ux-writing
skills.description: Use when interface copy is vague, cute, or blaming, or when writing buttons, errors, empty states, onboarding, and settings labels that must be clear in English and Indonesian.
skills.description_id: Gunakan saat teks antarmuka kabur, terlalu lucu, atau menyalahkan pengguna, atau saat menulis tombol, error, empty state, onboarding, dan label pengaturan yang harus jelas dalam bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia.
skills.author: ui-skill-2045 contributors
